name: challenge-the-design
description: Review each PR as an ensemble: challenge the problem, assumptions, and design, identify what code to delete while preserving all functionality, and check the implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Review PRs as an ensemble, challenge the design, and delete unnecessary code
interface.longDescription: Review each PR (or set of PRs) as an ensemble from the affected job and required guarantees. Challenge the requirement, ask what code you would delete while maintaining and preserving all functionality, compare viable alternatives, test assumptions, and check the implementation. Keep sound designs when their guarantees justify their cost.
defaultPrompt: Review each PR as an ensemble, and if you had to delete code while maintaining and preserving all functionality, what would you do?
Review this PR from first principles: challenge the problem, assumptions, and design, then check the implementation.
Compare this design with the strongest viable simpler alternative under the same guarantees and identify what would settle the decision.
